page.layout: One printed page. Running head centred at top; page number at top left. Below the head, a full-width engraving (emblem picture) with no text inside it. Below the engraving, a block of four verse lines set centred, each with a double-comma mark at the left margin. A catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: INVIDIA ÆGRITVDO OB alterius bona.
main_text.p: [engraving: emblem picture of a snake-haired figure of Envy on a pedestal, two dogs fighting at left, a naked man with a bellows-like object at right; no printed text]
main_text.l: ,, Omnibus in vitiis concurrit dæmonis æstus,
In sola invidia viscera tota quatit:
Discipuli Christi non est is nomine dignus,
Qui sæva invidiæ spicula mente gerit.

page.notes: The engraving carries no printed letters. The verse marks at the left are printed double commas (,,), shown here as in the scan. The running head reads "EMBLEMA" in small capitals. The heading is set in italic capitals with a second line "alterius bona." in italic lower case.
